subject: Tau's mitochondrial sabotage: reversing electron flow in Alzheimer's
script: From Agewell Brief: Tau's mitochondrial sabotage: reversing electron flow in Alzheimer's. New research suggests tau protein disrupts mitochondrial electron transport, reversing flow at Complex I, boosting ROS and cutting ATP—a mechanism distinct from the classic tangles. Alzheimer's disease has long been defined by amyloid plaques and tau tangles. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
